result.instructions: Tools for Megaventory, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "How much stock do we have of each product in the main warehouse?"; "Which sales orders are still pending this month?"; "Which purchase orders have we placed with our suppliers recently?". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Megaventory data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run megaventory_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run megaventory_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run megaventory_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. megaventory_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: megaventory_get_current_user
tools.title: Get current user
tools.description: The Megaventory user this API key belongs to (user name and whether they are an administrator). The key itself and the mobile PIN are never returned. POST /User/UserGet.

tools.name: megaventory_list_products
tools.title: List products
tools.description: Search the product catalog: SKU, description, category, prices (selling, purchase, unit cost), dimensions, main supplier, sellable/purchasable flags and more. Filter by id, exact SKU, category, main supplier or words in the description. Empty text fields are omitted. POST /Product/ProductGet.

product_id.description: Only the product with this id.

sku.description: Only the product with exactly this SKU.

search.description: Products whose description contains this text.

category_id.description: Only products in this category (see megaventory_list_product_categories).

main_supplier_id.description: Only products whose main supplier has this id.

show_deleted.description: Whether to include deleted records (default: only undeleted).

filters.description: Extra filters, all combined with AND. Field names are the property names shown in the results (case-insensitive).

field.description: A field of the record, for example SalesOrderClientID or ProductSellingPrice.

limit.description: How many records to return, 1-100 (default 25). Megaventory returns the newest records first (highest id) and has no page offset: narrow with filters instead of paging.

tools.name: megaventory_create_client_or_supplier
tools.title: Create client or supplier
tools.description: WRITE: create a NEW client, supplier or both in Megaventory (Insert only: an existing record is never updated, nothing is deleted). Creating the same name twice creates two records, so search with megaventory_list_clients_suppliers first. POST /SupplierClient/SupplierClientUpdate.

type.description: Whether the record is a client, a supplier or both.

tools.name: megaventory_create_sales_order
tools.title: Create pending sales order
tools.description: WRITE: create a NEW sales order for an existing client in the PENDING status. A pending order is only a draft document: it is not verified, nothing is shipped, invoiced or paid, and stock is not touched. Verifying, shipping and invoicing happen in Megaventory, not through this server. POST /SalesOrder/SalesOrderUpdate.

unit_price.description: Unit price before tax and discount; omitted = the product's default price.

location_id.description: Inventory location the order is served from (megaventory_list_inventory_locations).

type_id.description: Document type id of the sales order (default 3, the standard Sales Order type; see megaventory_list_document_types).

tools.name: megaventory_create_purchase_order
tools.title: Create pending purchase order
tools.description: WRITE: create a NEW purchase order to an existing supplier in the PENDING status. A pending order is only a draft document: it is not verified or sent, nothing is received, invoiced or paid, and stock is not touched. Verifying and receiving happen in Megaventory, not through this server. POST /PurchaseOrder/PurchaseOrderUpdate.

unit_price.description: Unit price before tax and discount; omitted = the product's default price.

location_id.description: Inventory location the goods are received into (megaventory_list_inventory_locations).

type_id.description: Document type id of the purchase order (default 4, the standard Purchase Order type; see megaventory_list_document_types).
